_comment: EMV tag dictionary. Names and formats follow the public EMV 4.x Books (EMVCo, free download), mainly Book 3 Annex A. Descriptions are written in our own words. 'display' picks the value formatter; 'mask' marks sensitive data (pan = first 6 + last 4, track2 = PAN rule then full mask, full = everything hidden).

tags.name: Issuer Identification Number (IIN)
tags.description: Leading digits of the PAN identifying the issuer.

tags.name: Application Identifier (AID) - card
tags.description: RID (5 bytes) followed by the proprietary application identifier extension.

tags.name: Application Label
tags.description: Mnemonic associated with the AID, shown to the cardholder.

tags.name: Track 1 Data
tags.description: Track 1 image as encoded on the magnetic stripe.

tags.name: Track 2 Equivalent Data
tags.description: PAN, separator 'D', expiry date, service code and discretionary data, as on track 2.

tags.name: Application Primary Account Number (PAN)
tags.description: Card number, padded with 'F' when the digit count is odd.

tags.name: Cardholder Name
tags.description: Cardholder name as on the card.

tags.name: Application Expiration Date
tags.description: Date after which the application expires.

tags.name: Application Effective Date
tags.description: Date from which the application may be used.

tags.name: Issuer Country Code
tags.description: ISO 3166 numeric country code of the issuer.

tags.name: Transaction Currency Code
tags.description: ISO 4217 numeric currency code of the transaction.

tags.name: Language Preference
tags.description: One to four ISO 639 alpha-2 language codes in order of preference.

tags.name: Service Code
tags.description: Service code as defined for magnetic stripe cards.

tags.name: Application PAN Sequence Number
tags.description: Distinguishes cards sharing the same PAN.

tags.name: Transaction Currency Exponent
tags.description: Position of the decimal point in the transaction amount.

tags.name: Application Template
tags.description: Directory entry holding application data objects.

tags.name: File Control Information (FCI) Template
tags.description: Returned in the response to SELECT.

tags.name: READ RECORD Response Message Template
tags.description: Template holding the data objects of a record.

tags.name: Issuer Script Template 1
tags.description: Issuer script commands to run before the final GENERATE AC.

tags.name: Issuer Script Template 2
tags.description: Issuer script commands to run after the final GENERATE AC.

tags.name: Response Message Template Format 2
tags.description: Constructed response template (TLV coded).

tags.name: Response Message Template Format 1
tags.description: Primitive response with concatenated values and no tags.

tags.name: Application Interchange Profile (AIP)
tags.description: Functions the card supports in the application.

tags.name: Dedicated File (DF) Name
tags.description: Name of the selected application file, usually the AID.

tags.name: Issuer Script Command
tags.description: A single command inside an issuer script.

tags.name: Application Priority Indicator
tags.description: Priority of the application among others on the card.

tags.name: Short File Identifier (SFI)
tags.description: Identifies an elementary file.

tags.name: Authorisation Code
tags.description: Approval code returned by the issuer.

tags.name: Authorisation Response Code
tags.description: Disposition of the transaction (e.g. 00, Y1, Z3).

tags.name: Card Risk Management Data Object List 1 (CDOL1)
tags.description: Tags and lengths the terminal sends in the first GENERATE AC.

tags.name: Card Risk Management Data Object List 2 (CDOL2)
tags.description: Tags and lengths the terminal sends in the second GENERATE AC.

tags.name: Cardholder Verification Method (CVM) List
tags.description: Amounts X and Y followed by the card's ordered CV Rules.

tags.name: Certification Authority Public Key Index
tags.description: Identifies which CA public key to use for offline data authentication.

tags.name: Issuer Public Key Certificate
tags.description: Issuer public key certified by the certification authority.

tags.name: Issuer Authentication Data
tags.description: Data sent to the card for online issuer authentication (e.g. ARPC).

tags.name: Issuer Public Key Remainder
tags.description: Part of the issuer public key that does not fit in the certificate.

tags.name: Signed Static Application Data
tags.description: Digital signature over critical application data, used by SDA.

tags.name: Application File Locator (AFL)
tags.description: Files and records the terminal must read.

tags.name: Terminal Verification Results (TVR)
tags.description: Status of the checks the terminal performed during the transaction.

tags.name: Transaction Certificate Data Object List (TDOL)
tags.description: Data used to build the TC hash value.

tags.name: Transaction Certificate (TC) Hash Value
tags.description: Hash of the data listed in the TDOL.

tags.name: Transaction Personal Identification Number (PIN) Data
tags.description: PIN data entered by the cardholder.

tags.name: Transaction Date
tags.description: Local date the transaction was authorised.

tags.name: Transaction Status Information (TSI)
tags.description: Functions the terminal performed during the transaction.

tags.name: Transaction Type
tags.description: Type of financial transaction, first two digits of the ISO 8583 processing code (00 = purchase, 01 = cash, 09 = cashback, 20 = refund).

tags.name: Directory Definition File (DDF) Name
tags.description: Name of a directory definition file.

tags.name: Acquirer Identifier
tags.description: Identifies the acquirer within each payment system.

tags.name: Amount, Authorised (Numeric)
tags.description: Authorised amount of the transaction, excluding adjustments.

tags.name: Amount, Other (Numeric)
tags.description: Secondary amount, such as the cashback part of a purchase.

tags.name: Amount, Other (Binary)
tags.description: Secondary amount in binary.

tags.name: Application Discretionary Data
tags.description: Issuer or payment system specific data.

tags.name: Application Identifier (AID) - terminal
tags.description: AID as known to the terminal.

tags.name: Application Usage Control
tags.description: Issuer's restrictions on geography and allowed services.

tags.name: Application Version Number - card
tags.description: Version of the application assigned by the payment system, as on the card.

tags.name: Application Version Number - terminal
tags.description: Version of the application assigned by the payment system, as in the terminal.

tags.name: Cardholder Name Extended
tags.description: Cardholder name when longer than 26 characters.

tags.name: Issuer Action Code - Default
tags.description: TVR conditions that make the issuer reject a transaction that could not go online.

tags.name: Issuer Action Code - Denial
tags.description: TVR conditions that make the issuer deny the transaction without going online.

tags.name: Issuer Action Code - Online
tags.description: TVR conditions that make the issuer want the transaction sent online.

tags.name: Issuer Application Data (IAD)
tags.description: Proprietary data for the issuer, carried in the online message.

tags.name: Issuer Code Table Index
tags.description: ISO/IEC 8859 part used to display the Application Preferred Name.

tags.name: Application Preferred Name
tags.description: Preferred mnemonic associated with the AID.

tags.name: Last Online Application Transaction Counter (ATC) Register
tags.description: ATC value of the last transaction authorised online.

tags.name: Lower Consecutive Offline Limit
tags.description: Offline transactions allowed before the terminal prefers online.

tags.name: Merchant Category Code
tags.description: Classifies the merchant's type of business (ISO 18245).

tags.name: Merchant Identifier
tags.description: Identifies the merchant at the acquirer.

tags.name: PIN Try Counter
tags.description: Remaining offline PIN attempts.

tags.name: Issuer Script Identifier
tags.description: Identifies an issuer script.

tags.name: Terminal Country Code
tags.description: ISO 3166 numeric country code of the terminal.

tags.name: Terminal Floor Limit
tags.description: Amount above which online authorisation is required.

tags.name: Terminal Identification
tags.description: Identifies the terminal at the acquirer.

tags.name: Terminal Risk Management Data
tags.description: Application specific risk management data from the terminal.

tags.name: Interface Device (IFD) Serial Number
tags.description: Manufacturer serial number of the card reader.

tags.name: Track 1 Discretionary Data
tags.description: Discretionary part of track 1.

tags.name: Track 2 Discretionary Data
tags.description: Discretionary part of track 2.

tags.name: Transaction Time
tags.description: Local time the transaction was authorised.

tags.name: Certification Authority Public Key Index - terminal
tags.description: CA public key index as known to the terminal.

tags.name: Upper Consecutive Offline Limit
tags.description: Offline transactions allowed before the card requires online.

tags.name: Application Cryptogram (AC)
tags.description: Cryptogram returned by GENERATE AC (AAC, TC or ARQC).

tags.name: Cryptogram Information Data (CID)
tags.description: Type of cryptogram returned and any action the terminal must take.

tags.name: Issuer Public Key Exponent
tags.description: Exponent of the issuer public key.

tags.name: Terminal Capabilities
tags.description: Card input, cardholder verification and security capabilities of the terminal.

tags.name: Cardholder Verification Method (CVM) Results
tags.description: Outcome of cardholder verification: method, condition and result.

tags.name: Terminal Type
tags.description: Operational environment of the terminal (attended/unattended, online capability, operator).

tags.name: Application Transaction Counter (ATC)
tags.description: Counter maintained by the card, incremented for every transaction.

tags.name: Unpredictable Number
tags.description: Random value from the terminal, input to the cryptogram.

tags.name: Processing Options Data Object List (PDOL)
tags.description: Tags and lengths the terminal sends in GET PROCESSING OPTIONS.

tags.name: Point-of-Service (POS) Entry Mode
tags.description: How the PAN was entered, first two digits of ISO 8583 field 22.

tags.name: Amount, Reference Currency
tags.description: Authorised amount expressed in the reference currency.

tags.name: Application Reference Currency
tags.description: Currencies the card may use besides the application currency.

tags.name: Transaction Reference Currency Code
tags.description: Currency used for reference amounts in the terminal.

tags.name: Transaction Reference Currency Exponent
tags.description: Decimal point position for reference currency amounts.

tags.name: Additional Terminal Capabilities
tags.description: Transaction types, data input and output capabilities of the terminal.

tags.name: Transaction Sequence Counter
tags.description: Counter maintained by the terminal, incremented for every transaction.

tags.name: Application Currency Code
tags.description: ISO 4217 numeric currency the card account is kept in.

tags.name: Application Reference Currency Exponent
tags.description: Exponents of the application reference currencies.

tags.name: Application Currency Exponent
tags.description: Decimal point position for amounts in the application currency.

tags.name: Data Authentication Code
tags.description: Issuer-assigned code recovered during SDA.

tags.name: ICC Public Key Certificate
tags.description: ICC public key certified by the issuer.

tags.name: ICC Public Key Exponent
tags.description: Exponent of the ICC public key.

tags.name: ICC Public Key Remainder
tags.description: Part of the ICC public key that does not fit in the certificate.

tags.name: Dynamic Data Authentication Data Object List (DDOL)
tags.description: Tags and lengths the terminal sends in INTERNAL AUTHENTICATE.

tags.name: Static Data Authentication Tag List
tags.description: Tags whose values are included in static data authentication.

tags.name: Signed Dynamic Application Data
tags.description: Digital signature produced by the card for DDA or CDA.

tags.name: ICC Dynamic Number
tags.description: Time-variant number generated by the card.

tags.name: Log Entry
tags.description: SFI and number of records of the transaction log.

tags.name: Merchant Name and Location
tags.description: Merchant name and location.

tags.name: Log Format
tags.description: Tags and lengths of the entries in the transaction log.

tags.name: Transaction Category Code
tags.description: Payment system specific category of the transaction (commonly used by Mastercard).

tags.name: Issuer Script Results
tags.description: Outcome of each issuer script command processed by the terminal.

tags.name: Terminal Transaction Qualifiers (TTQ)
tags.description: Contactless capabilities and requirements of the terminal (kernel specific).

tags.name: Form Factor Indicator / Third Party Data
tags.description: Payment system specific: form factor of the device (e.g. Visa) or third party data (e.g. Mastercard).

tags.name: Customer Exclusive Data
tags.description: Issuer data carried to the issuer host (kernel specific).

tags.name: File Control Information (FCI) Proprietary Template
tags.description: Issuer and payment system data returned with SELECT.

tags.name: File Control Information (FCI) Issuer Discretionary Data
tags.description: Issuer discretionary data returned with SELECT.
